summary: Cadeler A/S filed a 6-K announcing a Danish-to-UK redomiciliation via a voluntary share-exchange offer by new holding company Cadeler plc for all outstanding Cadeler shares, one-for-one, with each ADS exchanged for four plc shares. The F-4 EU EEA prospectus and US offer-to-exchange launched 21 September 2026; the board fully supports the transaction. Post-offer ownership percentages remain identical. This is a reorganization rather than a going-private sale; mechanics and any regulatory or listing clocks are unspecified, and completion timing and minimum acceptance conditions remain key watch items.
